2609.04485.title: Cultural Misalignment in Large Language Models: Detection, Measurement, and Mitigation Through Targeted Fine-Tuning
2609.04485.paper_summary: We evaluate three open-weight LLMs (Gemma3-12B from the USA, Bielik-11B-v3 from Poland, and Qwen3-4B from China) against World Values Survey Wave 7 data for 63 demographic personas across three countries, using normalized Wasserstein distance to quantify distributional misalignment. Contrary to expectations, no model favors its home country: the Chinese-built Qwen3-4B performs worst on its own Chinese population (W1 = 0.436, the highest misalignment in the entire model x country matrix). Targeted LoRA fine-tuning on the five worst-case personas, requiring fewer than 1,200 training pairs and under 15 minutes on a single GPU, reduces bias by 16.8% for Bielik-11B (p_Bonf = 0.002, d = -4.4) with all five targets improving. However, country-level decomposition reveals that fine-tuning redistributes rather than removes bias: Bielik's worst-case personas swap entirely from American to Chinese elderly, with zero overlap between pre- and post-correction sets. To our knowledge, this is the first study to target worst-case demographic personas with LoRA fine-tuning for cross-cultural bias mitigation.
2609.04485.paper_summary_zh: 我們評估了三個開放權重的 LLM（來自美國的 Gemma3-12B、來自波蘭的 Bielik-11B-v3 和來自中國的 Qwen3-4B），並使用標準化的 Wasserstein 距離來量化三個國家 63 個人口特徵的分佈不一致性，對應於世界價值觀調查第七波數據。與預期相反，沒有任何模型偏向其本國：中國製造的 Qwen3-4B 在其本國人口中的表現最差（W1 = 0.436，整個模型 x 國家矩陣中最高的不一致性）。對五個最糟糕的人口特徵進行針對性的 LoRA 微調，所需的訓練對數少於 1,200 對，且在單個 GPU 上耗時不到 15 分鐘，對 Bielik-11B 的偏見減少了 16.8%（p_Bonf = 0.002，d = -4.4），所有五個目標均有所改善。然而，國家層面的分解顯示，微調是重新分配而不是消除偏見：Bielik 的最糟糕人口特徵完全從美國老年人轉變為中國老年人，並且在修正前後的數據集之間沒有重疊。據我們所知，這是首個針對最糟糕人口特徵進行 LoRA 微調以減輕跨文化偏見的研究。
2609.04485.author: Antoni Czolgowski et.al.
